symptom: A matching VERIFIED_SUCCESS and NEW_FAILURE with the same millisecond createdAt relied on input order, so the gate could reuse a stale success instead of failing closed on the failure.
lesson: Equal-timestamp decisive learning must have deterministic fail-closed precedence; a NEW_FAILURE at the same recorded instant as a reusable success must prevent stale guardrail reuse.
guardrail: When createdAt ties for the same normalized identity, order NEW_FAILURE as newer than VERIFIED_SUCCESS for gate evaluation and after VERIFIED_SUCCESS for chronological retry-epoch counting.
